name: Sado Island Gold Mines
description: Sado Island Gold Mines lie on Sado Island, about 35 kilometres off Japan's Niigata coast in the Sea of Japan. The listing covers three areas that show how gold and silver were won without machines: panning ancient placer deposits at Nishimikawa, and digging out ore veins at the surface and deep underground around Aikawa-Tsurushi. Tunnels and mountainside scars still mark the landscape.
